 Addendum/Corrigendum 
 In continuation to the Advertisement No. NPSC-1/CESE-2026
dated 29.04.2026 and Addendum/Corrigendum dated 12.05.2026 the Commission
hereby notifies additional posts of 11 (Eleven) Assistant Professors in various
subjects.

 Corrigendum: Item No. 2 Assistant
Professor (English) Educational Qualifications may be read Masters in English/
English Literature/ Linguistics with NET/PhD.

No.5 Assistant
Professor (Mathematics): Masters in Mathematics and Computing with CSIR-UGC NET
in Mathematical Sciences are also eligible.

No. 14 Assistant
Professor (Computer Science): Masters in Computer Science/MCA/M.Tech with NET
or PhD.

No 33 . Lecturer (Interior
Design): The qualification be read as Bachelors degree in Interior Design with
minimum 1 st Class/1 st Division.
